edges.description: The variants reduce production of functional squalene synthase.
Flux from farnesyl diphosphate into squalene and on to cholesterol falls.
The substrate upstream of the block accumulates.

Sonic hedgehog is activated by covalent attachment of cholesterol, so a cholesterol shortfall is expected to impair the morphogen pathway. Inferred for SQSD by analogy with the post-squalene defects; not tested in SQSD.
Cholesterol is needed for embryonic development, particularly of the nervous system; the knockout mouse shows the extreme of this dependency.
Impaired morphogen signaling disturbs embryonic patterning.
Excess farnesyl diphosphate is dephosphorylated to farnesol and oxidized to farnesoic acid and farnesol-derived dicarboxylic acids, or conjugated.

nodes.description: Squalene synthase (farnesyl-diphosphate farnesyltransferase 1) catalyzes the reductive head-to-head condensation of two farnesyl diphosphate molecules to squalene, the first step committed to sterol rather than to other isoprenoid products. Its loss blocks the pathway at the branch point.

evidence.reference_title: Structural insights into the catalytic mechanism of human squalene synthase.
evidence.snippet: Squalene synthase (SQS) is a divalent metal-ion-dependent enzyme that catalyzes the two-step reductive `head-to-head' condensation of two molecules of farnesyl pyrophosphate to form squalene using presqualene diphosphate (PSPP) as an intermediate.

evidence.reference_title: The ER membrane protein complex promotes biogenesis of sterol-related enzymes maintaining cholesterol homeostasis.

nodes.description: Carbon diverted from sterol synthesis is converted to farnesol and then to saturated and unsaturated branched-chain dicarboxylic acids and farnesol glucuronides. In animals treated with a squalene synthase inhibitor this is the major fate of the diverted carbon, and the urinary profile it produces is the biochemical signature of the human disease. In inhibitor-treated mice farnesol formation was not detected, which the authors read as rapid onward conversion to farnesoic acid and dicarboxylic acids in the liver, so the measurable products are the acids and conjugates rather than farnesol itself.

nodes.description: Reduced sonic hedgehog signaling in the developing embryo secondary to insufficient cholesterol. Experimental cholesterol deficiency in rodents produces the limb, genital, brain and facial malformations of Smith-Lemli-Opitz syndrome with loss of ventral neural tube Shh expression. For SQSD this node is an inference by analogy: no study has measured hedgehog signaling in FDFT1-deficient tissue.
